limits: Bounded seeds/counts and finite rivals only; qualification remains the native authority.

self_review.question: Can a plausible wrong rule fit every visible demo yet disagree on a query?
self_review.scope: Only the three named finite rivals were tested; this is not universal uniqueness.

tested_rivals.program:
(rule!
 (let ((dummy 0))
   (define (f14-full-cols grid color)
     (filter (lambda (c)
               (all? (lambda (r) (= (at grid r c) color))
                     (range (rows grid))))
             (range (cols grid))))
   (define (f14-full-col grid color)
     (let ((hits (f14-full-cols grid color)))
       (if (empty? hits) #f (first hits))))
   (define (f14-mirror grid)
     (let ((div (f14-full-col grid 9)))
       (if (not div)
           grid
           (for*/fold ((out grid))
                      ((r (in-range (rows grid)))
                       (c (in-range div)))
             (let ((v (at grid r c))
                   (mc (+ div (- div c))))
               (if (and (not (member? v (list 0 9)))
                        (in-bounds? r mc (rows grid) (cols grid)))
                   (set-cell out r mc v)
                   out))))))
   (define (f14-next-to-probe? grid r c)
     (or (and (> r 0) (= (at grid (- r 1) c) 2))
         (and (< (+ r 1) (rows grid)) (= (at grid (+ r 1) c) 2))
         (and (> c 0) (= (at grid r (- c 1)) 2))
         (and (< (+ c 1) (cols grid)) (= (at grid r (+ c 1)) 2))))
   (define (f14-color-touches-probe? grid color)
     (for/or ((r (range (rows grid))))
       (for/or ((c (range (cols grid))))
         (and (= (at grid r c) color)
              (f14-next-to-probe? grid r c)))))
   (define (f14-color-cells grid color)
     (for*/list ((r (range (rows grid)))
                 (c (range (cols grid)))
                 #:when (= (at grid r c) color))
       (list r c)))
   (define (f14-fill-bbox grid cells color)
     (let* ((r0 (min-of first cells))
            (r1 (max-of first cells))
            (c0 (min-of second cells))
            (c1 (max-of second cells)))
       (for*/fold ((out grid))
                  ((r (in-range r0 (+ r1 1)))
                   (c (in-range c0 (+ c1 1))))
         (set-cell out r c color))))
   (let* ((mirrored (f14-mirror g))
          (candidate (cond
                       ((f14-color-touches-probe? mirrored 3) 3)
                       ((f14-color-touches-probe? mirrored 4) 4)
                       (else #f))))
     (if (not candidate)
         mirrored
         (let* ((cells (f14-color-cells mirrored candidate))
                (fill-color 1))
           (f14-fill-bbox mirrored cells fill-color))))))
